ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark field (>90% pixels) with localized high-intensity white clusters scattered across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the primary fluke surface; high-contrast white focal spots and ring-shaped clusters distributed sporadically; dense white contiguous clusters located at the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 65 degrees with clear pixel-defined convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire visible margin; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in depth relative to the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the upper trailing edge segments transitioning into a sharp convex sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular/annular high-contrast white rings (dark centers) scattered across the mid-section of both lobes; highest concentration on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, high-intensity white linear streaks visible on the left lobe, oriented at approximately 45 degrees to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white calcified-appearing clusters (likely barnacle colonization) at the left and right fluke tips; several white linear and circular disruptions of the dark pigmentation field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'donut' scar pattern distribution across the central fluke area.
